vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the weekly schedule and grouping so they arrive immediately, one PR each

packageRules.description: Group all patch updates (npm, Docker, GitHub Actions) into one weekly PR
Keep minor/major bumps separate and ungrouped so they get individual review
react and react-dom throw at startup unless their versions match exactly, so they must always be bumped together (declared last so it wins over the ungrouped minor/major rule)
